pkgmetadata.longdescription: Shidashi builds the Bentoo images from an official, verified Gentoo stage3: every stage of the chain (base, minimal, desktop, flavor) is built in an isolated systemd-nspawn container, the packages it compiles land in a binhost as binpkgs, and the live ISOs are assembled from that binhost without compiling anything. The ::gentoo snapshot and the overlays are pinned, and every run leaves an audit trail.

use.flag: Pull in the tools that assemble the live ISO: sys-fs/squashfs-tools (the root filesystem), dev-libs/libisoburn (xorriso) and sys-boot/grub with sys-fs/mtools (the hybrid BIOS and UEFI medium made by grub-mkrescue)
Pull in what 'shidashi vm' needs to boot an ISO and test it: app-emulation/qemu, the OVMF firmware for UEFI boots, and an SSH client to drive the VM over vsock
